name: tip_n
comment: Number of tips (grooves)

name: tip_d
comment: T12 shaft diameter

name: tip_len
comment: T12 overall length, connector end to working tip (bent tips included)

name: ring_d
comment: Diameter of the two collars on the shaft

name: ring_y1
comment: First collar position, from the connector end

name: ring_y2
comment: Second collar position, from the connector end

name: ring_w
comment: Collar pocket length (generous: collar positions vary between makers)

name: clear
comment: Radial clearance round the shaft and collars

name: groove_d
comment: Tip groove diameter

name: ring_pd
comment: Collar pocket diameter

name: pitch
comment: Groove spacing (X)

name: edge_m
comment: Extra side room between the outer grooves and the side walls

name: end_clear
comment: Room at each end of the tip

name: tip_zone
comment: Working-end zone: open trough to the floor so bent tips (e.g. JL02) fit

name: bend_h
comment: Room for a bent tip from the shaft axis, up and down

name: wall
comment: Wall thickness (side walls carry the lid dovetail)

name: base_t
comment: Floor thickness under the tip zone

name: corner_r
comment: Outer vertical corner radius

name: foot_ch
comment: 45 deg chamfer round the box bottom edge (against elephant foot)

name: top_ch
comment: 45 deg chamfer round the box top outer edge and the front wall top

name: lid_ch
comment: 45 deg chamfer on the lid's front and back top edges (the lid's bed side)

name: lid_t
comment: Lid thickness

name: lid_land
comment: Vertical land at the lid's long bottom edges before the 45 deg bevel (no knife edge)

name: lid_recess
comment: Lid top sits this far below the box top

name: lip_ch
comment: 45 deg chamfer on the wall's inner top edge above the lid

name: dov
comment: Dovetail: how far the lid's lower edge reaches into each side wall

name: lid_c
comment: Lid sliding clearance

name: lid_engage
comment: Lid end tucks this far into the back wall

name: tongue_l
comment: Click tongue length

name: slot_w
comment: Width of the slots either side of the tongue

name: click_r
comment: Click bump radius (under the tongue)

name: click_notch_r
comment: Click notch radius in the front wall top

name: ramp
comment: 45 deg ramp on the front wall's inner top edge, lets the bump ride up

name: scoop_r
comment: Finger scoop radius across the bed

name: scoop_d
comment: Finger scoop depth below the bed top

name: scoop_y
comment: Finger scoop position from the connector end

name: Wi
comment: Inner width

name: Li
comment: Inner length

name: W
comment: Outer width (X)

name: L
comment: Outer length (Y)

name: z_axis
comment: Height of the tip axes = bed top

name: z_lid
comment: Lid underside

name: H
comment: Overall height (lid top lid_recess below the wall tops)

name: x0
comment: X of the first groove

name: y0
comment: Y of the tip connector end

name: tongue_w
comment: Click tongue width (flexible strip at the lid front), at most half the inner width
